verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a tax-compliance API/SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant runtime that would itself consume tools via MCP. The only MCP-related evidence shows Kintsugi exposing an MCP *server* so external AI coding assistants can query its docs/API (kintsugi-docs-6, kintsugi-docs-18, kintsugi-probe-3) — the opposite direction from 'plugging MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools.' There is no agentic component in Kintsugi that would act as an MCP client, so this axis does not apply.
